Provides Paginator, MutablePaginator, PagingCore, PaginatorPrefetchController, the offset DSL, eviction strategies, and the offset serialization layer. Builds on paginator-core. items.title: io.github.jamal-wia:paginator-compose-core-wasm-js 10.2.4 发布, Compose Multiplatform UI utilities shared between paginator-compose-offset and paginator-compose-cursor. Contains the scroll-position preservation primitives (ScrollSnapshot data classes, ScrollSnapshotRegistry, internal save/restore composables) that back the `preserveScroll = true` parameter on BindToLazyList / BindToLazyGrid / BindToLazyStaggeredGrid, plus the shared scroll-binder core (BindScrollInternal) and PrefetchErrorChannel. Depends only on paginator-core (for the ScrollWindow index-remapping math); independent of paginator-offset and paginator-cursor.
